verdict.rationale: Floot's editor includes a live preview with device frame switching (Desktop, iPhone, Pixel, iPad, resizable Responsive) and lets users point at elements or annotate screenshots for the AI to act on, all before the one-click publish step that goes live. This clearly shows an interactive pre-publish preview workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of real-time responsiveness during iterative edits, and more detail on how live the preview updates are during active building.
